title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**Growth Marketing Manager**

**About Cove Offices**

Cove Offices is a managed-office and flexible-workspace company operating business centres across Chennai, Bengaluru and Coimbatore. We serve customers ranging from small businesses seeking ready-to-use offices to enterprises requiring large, customised managed workspaces.

We are strengthening our internal marketing function and are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager who can take day-to-day ownership of digital campaigns, lead tracking, CRM processes and marketing execution.

**Role Details**

**Designation:** Growth Marketing Manager  
**Employment:** Full-time, in office  
**Experience:** Approximately 4–6 years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Reporting to:** Chief Growth Officer and Cove’s Founder Team  
**Coordination with:** Sales, telecalling, centre teams, website partners and external creative or technical specialists

**Purpose of the Role**

The Growth Marketing Manager will be responsible for the daily execution and monitoring of Cove’s marketing activities.

The role requires someone who can personally work within advertising platforms, analytics tools and CRM systems; identify campaign, tracking and funnel problems; and ensure that marketing activity translates into qualified enquiries, site visits, proposals and closures.

This is a hands-on execution role rather than an advisory or agency-coordination position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Personally manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor campaign performance, budgets, audiences, keywords, search terms, creatives, landing pages and conversion metrics on a daily basis.
* Ensure accurate tracking of leads from advertisements, website forms, phone calls and WhatsApp through LeadSquared, qualification, site visits, proposals and closures.
* Reconcile data across advertising platforms, analytics, call records, website enquiries and LeadSquared, and promptly investigate discrepancies or missing leads.
* Analyse source-wise and centre-wise lead quality, response times and conversion rates, and work with sales and telecalling teams to identify funnel leakage.
* Clean, segment and reactivate Cove’s historical lead database through email, WhatsApp and lead-nurturing campaigns.
* Coordinate SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile management, website updates, landing pages and conversion improvements.
* Develop campaign and content briefs and coordinate designers, writers, video editors, website developers and other external specialists.
* Prepare clear daily, weekly and monthly reports covering campaign performance, lead quality, funnel conversion, pipeline and revenue.
* Maintain documentation of campaigns, account configurations, tracking systems, processes, tests, results and corrective actions.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have:

* Approximately 4–6 years of relevant growth or digital-marketing experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta campaigns.
* Experience in a lead-generation business where marketing enquiries are passed to a sales team.
* Practical understanding of conversion tracking, analytics, attribution and funnel measurement.
* Experience using CRM systems such as LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and reporting dashboards.
* Experience with database segmentation, email, WhatsApp, lead nurturing or reactivation.
* Working knowledge of SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profile management.
* Experience coordinating website developers, designers, content creators and external specialists.
* Strong analytical ability and comfort investigating incomplete or inconsistent data.
* Clear communication, documentation and process-management skills.
* A hands-on, accountable and execution-oriented approach.

Experience in B2B services, commercial real estate, managed offices, coworking, SaaS, education, financial services or another lead-driven, multi-location business would be advantageous.

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
description:
**Start Your Digital Marketing Career with Real Projects, Real Clients & Real Growth!**

**Location:** Coimbatore – Work from Office  
**Employment:** Full-Time Career Opportunity  
**Experience:** Freshers Only  
**Program:** 6-Month Training & Internship → Full-Time Employment  
**Salary After 6 Months:** ₹12,500–₹20,000/month, based on performance

About YS Innovations

At **YS Innovations**, we build software products, SaaS platforms, eCommerce solutions, and digital growth strategies that help businesses succeed online.

We're looking for an enthusiastic **Digital Marketing Executive** who wants to learn by doing, work on real projects, explore different marketing channels, and build a long-term career in digital marketing.

This isn't just about posting on social media. You'll get practical exposure to growing real businesses, generating leads, improving Google rankings, running advertising campaigns, and marketing our own SaaS products.

**If you're curious about digital marketing and ready to turn your interest into a career, we'd love to hear from you!**

What Will You Work On?

At YS Innovations, you'll gain hands-on experience across three exciting areas:

**1. Client Projects**

* Work on digital marketing campaigns for real clients across different industries.
* Help businesses improve their online visibility, website traffic, and lead generation.
* Plan and execute SEO, social media, content, and paid advertising activities.

**2. Our Own SaaS Products**

* Promote our software products and reach potential customers globally.
* Work on product launches, landing pages, email campaigns, and growth strategies.
* Explore how digital marketing helps SaaS businesses attract, convert, and retain customers.

**3. Digital Growth & Marketing Campaigns**

* Research keywords, competitors, and new marketing opportunities.
* Create engaging content for social media, blogs, and websites.
* Work with Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, analytics, and lead generation.
* Track campaign results and find ways to improve performance.

What Will You Learn?

You don't need to be an expert already. We'll help you develop practical skills in:

* **SEO:** Keyword research, on-page SEO, content optimization, and Google rankings.
* **Paid Advertising:** Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, and campaign optimization.
* **Social Media Marketing:** Content planning, publishing, engagement, and brand growth.
* **Content Marketing:** Blog writing, website content, landing pages, and promotional campaigns.
* **Lead Generation:** Finding potential customers and improving campaign conversions.
* **Analytics & Reporting:** Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and performance tracking.
* **SaaS & Product Marketing:** Promoting software products and reaching customers online.

Your 6-Month Career Journey

**Months 1–3: Practical Training**

* Learn digital marketing fundamentals through hands-on training.
* Work on practical assignments and real-world marketing activities.
* Develop your skills with guidance from the team.

**Stipend:** No stipend during the first three months.

**Months 4–6: Paid Internship**

* Take responsibility for actual marketing activities and campaigns.
* Work on client projects and our own SaaS products.
* Improve your execution, campaign analysis, and problem-solving skills.

**Stipend:** Up to ₹8,000 per month, based on performance.

**After 6 Months: Full-Time Digital Marketing Executive**

Candidates who successfully complete the program and meet the required performance standards will be considered for full-time employment.

**Expected salary: ₹12,500–₹20,000 per month, based on skills, performance, and contribution.**

Your growth will depend on what you learn, how you execute, the quality of your work, and the value you bring to the team.

Who Can Apply?

We're looking for candidates who:

* Are freshers or recent graduates interested in digital marketing.
* Have a basic understanding of SEO, social media, or online marketing — or are eager to learn.
* Enjoy creativity, research, problem-solving, and exploring new ideas.
* Are willing to learn through practical assignments and real projects.
* Can communicate clearly and work well with a team.
* Are ready to take responsibility and improve continuously.
* Can work from our Coimbatore office.
* Are comfortable with the six-month training and internship structure.

**No extensive work experience is required. Your willingness to learn, consistency, and attitude matter.**

Why Join YS Innovations?

✅ Work on real client projects instead of learning only through theory.

✅ Get exposure to our own SaaS products and software businesses.

✅ Learn SEO, paid advertising, content marketing, and lead generation.

✅ Understand how marketing drives traffic, leads, and sales.

✅ Work with a team involved in software development and digital growth.

✅ Build a practical portfolio of your work and experience.

✅ Get a clear opportunity to progress into a full-time role with a monthly salary of ₹12,500–₹20,000 based on performance.

Ready to Start Your Career?

You don't need to know everything on Day 1. You need curiosity, commitment, and the willingness to learn.

If you want to build a career in digital marketing while working on real businesses and products, **YS Innovations is ready to help you take the first step.**

**Send your resume to:** team@ysinnovations.com

**Salary:** ₹10,000 – ₹20,000/month \+ Performance\-Based Incentives

**Important: Please Read Before Applying**

This is **NOT a field\-sales role**.

✔ No field sales  
✔ No door\-to\-door sales  
✔ No cold calling  
✔ No random lead generation through personal contacts  
✔ Primarily **inbound leads, digital channels, client communication and business coordination**

***About RK Creators***

**RK Creators** is looking for an enthusiastic and career\-oriented **Business Development \& Marketing Executive** to support our growing business through **inbound lead management, digital marketing, client communication and business coordination**.

This opportunity is particularly suitable for candidates who want to develop practical skills across **digital marketing, business development, client handling and professional communication**.

You will receive structured guidance and hands\-on exposure rather than being expected to immediately perform as an experienced sales professional.

***What You'll Do***

As part of the business development and marketing team, your responsibilities will include:

* Responding to and managing **inbound enquiries and leads**
* Communicating with prospective clients through phone, WhatsApp, email and other professional channels
* Understanding client requirements and coordinating with the relevant internal team
* Following up with interested prospects and maintaining lead status
* Supporting **digital marketing activities**, including social media and email campaigns
* Assisting with preparation and sharing of proposals, quotations and other client documents
* Maintaining accurate client and lead records
* Coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and service delivery
* Supporting marketing initiatives and other business\-growth activities
* Learning and applying professional approaches to **lead management, client communication and business development**

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for candidates who are:

* Confident and professional in communication
* Comfortable speaking with clients and understanding their requirements
* Interested in **digital marketing, business development and client management**
* Willing to learn new tools, platforms and business processes
* Organized and capable of following up on multiple leads/tasks
* Positive, responsible and target\-oriented
* Comfortable working as part of an office\-based team

**Freshers Are Welcome**

You **do not need prior sales experience** to apply.

If you are a fresher with good communication skills, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in marketing or business development, we encourage you to apply.

Candidates with **0–1 year of experience** in business development, digital marketing, customer support, inside sales or client coordination may also apply.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Good verbal and written communication
* Basic knowledge of social media and digital platforms
* Basic MS Office / Google Workspace skills
* Good follow\-up and coordination ability
* Professional attitude and willingness to learn

**Added advantage:** Candidates with exposure to digital marketing, social media management, CRM tools, lead management or client communication.

**Why Join RK Creators?**

\-Structured Learning

Get practical training and guidance during the initial trainee phase.

\-Digital \& Business Exposure

Work with real client enquiries and gain hands\-on exposure to **digital marketing, business development and service\-based business operations**.

\-No Traditional Sales Pressure

The role does not involve field sales, door\-to\-door sales or cold\-calling campaigns.

\-Clear Career Growth

**Trainee → Business Development Executive → Senior Executive**

Your growth will be based on **performance, learning, communication skills and ability to handle responsibilities independently**.

\-Professional Work Environment

Work from our office in **Gandhipuram, Coimbatore**, alongside a team where you can learn through practical experience and day\-to\-day collaboration.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

This role would be a good fit if you are someone who:

**✔ Likes communicating with people**  
**✔ Wants to learn marketing and business development**  
**✔ Can take ownership of follow\-ups and tasks**

title: Social Media Marketeer
description:
**Job title** : Social Media Marketer

**Company:** Bytez Corp  
**Location:** Singanallur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu – 641005  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month (based on experience)  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 year preferred

**About Bytez Corp**

Bytez Corp is Tamil Nadu's premier full\-service branding agency, built on a simple promise — **"Your Growth is Our Responsibility."**

We work with businesses across different industries to build strong and memorable brands through creative branding, social media marketing, digital campaigns, and high\-quality visual content.

We are looking for a creative and energetic **Social Media Marketer** who can manage multiple client accounts, create engaging content, understand social media trends, and help brands grow their online presence.

**About the Role**

As a **Social Media Marketer**, you will be responsible for planning, creating, managing, and optimizing social media content for Bytez Corp and its client brands.

You will work closely with our **creative, design, video, and marketing teams** to develop content that increases brand awareness, engagement, followers, enquiries, and overall social media presence.

The ideal candidate should be **creative, trend\-aware, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute social media strategies for multiple client brands.
* Manage daily social media activities across **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms**.
* Create monthly and weekly **social media content calendars** based on client objectives.
* Research trending topics, hashtags, sounds, formats, and content ideas.
* Create engaging **Instagram Reels, Stories, Posts, Carousels, and short\-form videos**.
* Write creative captions, hooks, CTAs, and relevant hashtags.
* Coordinate with designers and video editors to develop high\-quality social media creatives.
* Create basic social media designs using **Canva** when required.
* Plan content around festivals, awareness days, events, promotions, and brand campaigns.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience interactions.
* Improve engagement and build an active online community for client brands.
* Research competitors and identify new content opportunities.
* Analyse social media performance using platform insights and analytics.
* Track important metrics such as **reach, impressions, engagement rate, followers, views, saves, shares, and leads**.
* Prepare simple weekly/monthly social media performance reports.
* Identify underperforming content and suggest improvements.
* Stay updated with **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube algorithm changes and emerging trends**.
* Work with the marketing team to align social media content with campaigns and business goals.
* Manage multiple client accounts and ensure content is published according to schedule.
* Maintain consistency in each client's **brand voice, visual identity, and communication style**.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of **Social Media Marketing**.
* Strong knowledge of **Instagram and Facebook**.
* Good understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, Carousels, and short\-form content.
* Ability to identify and adapt to current social media trends.
* Good content planning and idea\-generation skills.
* Strong **caption writing and communication skills**.
* Basic knowledge of Canva and social media creative design.
* Understanding of hashtags, audience targeting, engagement, and content optimization.
* Basic knowledge of social media analytics and insights.
* Ability to manage multiple social media accounts and deadlines.
* Good communication skills in **English and Tamil**.
* Creative thinking with attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a team.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience handling social media accounts for multiple brands or clients.
* Experience in a digital marketing or branding agency.
* Basic knowledge of **Meta Business Suite**.
* Basic knowledge of Instagram and Facebook advertising.
* Experience creating or coordinating Reels and short\-form videos.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, Google Trends, and social media analytics platforms**.
* Personal Instagram page, content portfolio, or previous social media work will be an added advantage.

**Who We're Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Thinks creatively and comes up with fresh content ideas.
* Understands what makes people stop scrolling.
* Keeps up with the latest social media trends.
* Can turn a simple business idea into engaging social media content.
* Is comfortable working with multiple brands and industries.
* Takes ownership of assigned accounts and deadlines.
* Is willing to learn new platforms, tools, and content formats.
* Has a strong interest in **Instagram, content creation, branding, and social media growth**.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on experience managing social media for multiple industries and brands.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world branding and content campaigns.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with designers, video editors, and marketing strategists.
* Career growth toward **Senior Social Media Marketer / Social Media Manager / Content Strategist** roles.
* Opportunity to develop strong skills in social media strategy, content creation, and client management.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their **resume and social media portfolio/work samples** to:

**Email:** info.bytezcorp@gmail.com  
**Contact:** Mr. Senthilkumar – 78715 31777

**Note:** Candidates with previous social media work, Instagram pages, Reels, campaign samples, or content portfolios are encouraged to share their work along with their resume.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
